dedupe_keys.name: ontology based data model for building characterizations

description: Ontology-based Data Model for Building Characterizations is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Karen Angeles, University of Notre Dame (nd.edu). The ontology-based data model for building characterizations provides a knowledge framework to support a uniform approach to building data management and streamline building data discovery for applications in loss estimation. The data model leverages ontology-based knowledge representations and an object-oriented approach to support characterizations of buildings and their components, including features and relational properties. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-yx2k-xx26. Keywords: loss estimation; open data; building; hurricane; ontology; risk assessment. Published 2021-01-22. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is GPL-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
